title: A double click on Create Credit Term creates one term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A new name {Term-A} that no term has.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-21 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Double-click "Create Credit Term" quickly.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: the button is disabled while saving; one toast "{Term-A} created" shows, no "already exists" error appears, and {Term-A} is listed once.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R14: “"Create Credit Term" and "Save Changes" are disabled while saving, so a double click saves once.”
